units.zh: 好古文奇字，妙於陰陽算曆。
units.en: He cherished archaic characters and excelled at yin-yang numerology and calendar science.
units.literal: He loved antique script and unusual graphs and excelled at yin-yang reckoning and calendars.

units.zh: 有郭公者，客居河東，精于卜筮，璞從之受業。
units.en: A visitor called Master Guo practiced divination in Hedong, and Guo Pu apprenticed himself to him.
units.literal: There was a Master Guo who lodged in Hedong and mastered divination; Pu studied under him.

units.zh: 公以《青囊中書》九卷與之，由是遂洞五行、天文、卜筮之術，攘災轉禍，通致無方，雖京房、管輅不能過也。
units.en: The master handed him nine volumes of The Satchel of Azure Secrets; Guo Pu thereby mastered the Five Agents, astronomy, and milfoil divination, turning aside disasters with uncanny ease—skills said to eclipse Jing Fang and Guan Lu.
units.literal: The elder gave him nine fascicles of The Satchel of Azure Secrets; thereafter Pu penetrated the arts of the Five Agents, astronomy, and divination—averting calamity and shifting fortune without fixed method—even Jing Fang and Guan Lu could not surpass him.

units.zh: 璞門人趙載嘗竊《青襄書》，未及讀，而為火所焚。
units.en: Disciple Zhao Zai once stole the azure satchel text; flames consumed it before he could open a page.
units.literal: Pu's disciple Zhao Zai once stole the Azure Satchel text; before he could read it fire burned it.

units.zh: 臣謹尋按舊經，《尚書》有五事供禦之術，京房《易傳》有消復之救，所以緣咎而致慶，因異而邁政。
units.en: I have carefully sought through the old classics: the Shangshu has arts for responding to the Five Matters, and Jing Fang's Yizhuan has rescues for waning and returning; these are ways to follow blame and bring about blessing, and to use anomalies to advance government.
units.literal: I have carefully sought through the old classics: the Shangshu has arts for responding to the Five Matters, and Jing Fang's Yizhuan has rescues for waning and returning; these are ways to follow blame and bring about blessing, and to use anomalies to advance government.
